$comment: Read from the chain, not from our database. Compare sha256(names.json) with the published hash. See docs/trust-model.md.

scan.howToRead: Events were read newest-first in chunks. The scan stopped after this many consecutive chunks with no events, so a name minted before that point would be missed — and the count is printed instead of assumed.

coverage: Names minted through this registrar. A name created by a different registrar would not appear; security-power-inventory.mjs is what watches for one.
